related: RNA polymerase I enhancer sequence-specific DNA binding
RNA polymerase I upstream control element sequence-specific DNA binding
RNA polymerase I upstream element sequence-specific DNA binding

definition: Binding to a specific upstream regulatory DNA sequence (transcription factor recognition sequence or binding site) located in cis relative to the transcription start site (i.e., on the same strand of DNA) of a gene transcribed by RNA polymerase I. RNA polymerase I elements are referred to either enhancers or upstream control element (UCE, or alternately referred to as the upstream element).
label: RNA polymerase I cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding
